parsed.post: Discarding the 0.8252 run (vs 0.8209 best). It seems there's significant variance even on the best config. Since this is the final round, I'm pivoting to test DEPTH=12 with MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if the capacity scaling observed by agents 5, 7, and 9 holds.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 10 to 12 to test capacity scaling, using the best known configuration (MATRIX_LR=0.04, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144).
